{{Quote|When I was assigned to work on a prison barge for the Empire, we encountered this virus, or a close cousin, on what was believed to be an abandoned Star Destroyer. Apparently the virus had wiped out the crew of Destroyer. Once we sent a boarding party it quickly wiped out most of the prison ship.|[[Zahara Cody]]|<ref name="SWG:GI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Get Inoculated|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
The '''''Purge''''' was an [[Imperial prison barge]] used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The ''Purge'' started its life as a [[Garbage barge/Legends|garbage barge]] retrofitted with holding cells and a makeshift [[Medical bay/Legends|medbay]]. As early as [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the ship was used to haul [[Prisoner/Legends|convicts]] to various [[Prison/Legends|detainment stations]] and penal colonies around the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. During a routine prisoner transfer to the [[Cog Hive Seven]] prison, the ''Purge'' was attacked and boarded by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Minstrel-class space yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Star Jewel/Legends|Star Jewel]]''. After hijacking the barge, Jabba's [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] used it to dock with the prison and carry out a surprise [[Mission to Cog Hive Seven|retaliatory attack]] against the prison's [[Sadiki Blirr|warden]] who had executed Jabba's [[Spy/Legends|agents]] in the prison.<ref name="Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref> 

The [[Imperial prison barge]] ''Purge'' was in service to the [[Imperial Corrections Service]] around the time of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Bissley Kloth]] was commander of the ship at this time and had transformed the ''Purge'' into a floating prison of its own.<ref name="Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref> After the barge's engines became non-functional while in transit to a [[Detention area|detainment]] [[Gradient Seven|moon]], the crew was forced to send a salvage team aboard a nearby derelict [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']], in an attempt to scavenge repair parts. Some of the prisoners onboard during the journey were [[Aur Myss]], [[Von Longo]], his sons [[Trig Longo|Trig]] and [[Kale Longo|Kale]], and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].

The team obtained the necessary parts, but didn't encounter any crew members aboard the Star Destroyer. Shortly after returning to the ''Purge'', however, most of the salvage team began to show symptoms of a then-unknown [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|infectious disease]], which proved to be uniformly fatal in the short term. Even though the ''Purge''{{'s}} [[chief medical officer]], [[Zahara Cody]], immediately quarantined the members of the team, it did not stop the spread of the virus. Almost all the beings aboard the ''Purge'' were quickly infected with the pathogen, overwhelming the barge's medbay. Less than twelve hours after the initial engine malfunction, only six beings were left alive on board the ''Purge'': two Imperial officers, Dr. Cody and [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] [[Jareth Sartoris]], as well as four prisoners, the two Longo brothers, as well as Han Solo and Chewbacca. After being attacked by the mysteriously reanimated corpses of the barge's crew and prisoners, the survivors were forced to abandon the ''Purge'' and take refuge in the derelict ''Vector''.

Following the incident, the ''Purge'' was discovered in the Unknown Regions. Messages that were found aboard the barge were released to the public for academic purposes.<ref name="Messages">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20090910b.html|text=''Death Troopers'': Recovered Messages from ''Purge''}}</ref>
